description: 嘉義市計程車招呼站地點 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 嘉義市政府. 依據《嘉義市市區道路管理自治條例》核准設置的計程車格路段. Coverage: 嘉義市政府. The portal files it under the publisher 嘉義市政府. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
